name: PodPoster
author: Armin Amiri Nasab

sections.description:
PodPoster turns your WordPress site into a fully functional podcast publishing powerhouse. Whether you’re an aspiring creator or a seasoned podcaster, PodPoster streamlines your workflow—so you can focus on content, not code.

With seamless integration into WordPress, PodPoster removes the friction from getting your podcast online:

  • Automatic RSS Feed Generation: Instantly create podcast-ready RSS feeds that meet industry standards. Submit to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Google Podcasts, and other major directories with confidence.
  • Streamlined Episode Management: Add new episodes just like blog posts—upload audio, write descriptions, include show notes, and add artwork—all from the WordPress dashboard you already know.
  • Own Your Content: Host everything on your own WordPress site. Maintain full control over your episodes, metadata, and audience. No more platform lock-ins or recurring fees.
  • Fast Setup, No Coding Needed: Designed for simplicity. You don’t need technical expertise to publish your first episode in minutes.

Whether you’re launching your first podcast or migrating from another platform, PodPoster provides the essential tools to manage, publish, and grow your show—all from the platform you already trust.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the podposter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the PodPoster settings panel in your dashboard to configure your podcast.
  4. Start publishing episodes using the new custom post type.
sections.faq:
Can I submit my PodPoster RSS feed to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and Google Podcasts?

Yes. The RSS feed generated by PodPoster fully complies with podcasting standards and is accepted by all major directories.

Where can I find my RSS feed?

The feed is located in the /rss/ folder inside your WordPress uploads directory. This folder is automatically created upon activation.

Does PodPoster display episodes on the front-end of my site?

PodPoster focuses on backend management and RSS feed generation. It registers custom post types for podcasts and episodes. Most themes do not display custom post types by default—custom integration may be required.
